messages.content: Why do gardeners water plants in the early morning rather than at noon?
Less water is lost that way. Because at noon the hot sun dries the soil quickly, while in the cool morning the water has time to soak down to the roots.
A meeting was moved from 2:00 p.m. to one and a half hours later. When does it start now?
It now starts at 3:30 p.m. Because one and a half hours is 1 hour and 30 minutes, and 2:00 plus that is 3:30.
Why do people usually sleep better in a dark, quiet room?
There is less to disturb them. Because light and noise keep the brain alert, while darkness and quiet help the body settle into deep sleep.
Why do neighbours greet each other even if they do not know one another well?
A greeting builds goodwill. Because people who live close share space, and a smile or hello makes the area feel safe and friendly.
Why do children get excited the night before a festival?
They are looking forward to something enjoyable. Because the mind keeps picturing the sweets, new clothes and family visits, and that eager feeling makes it hard to settle down.
Why do we tie our hair back near a flame or a machine?
Loose hair can catch fire or get pulled in. Because strands near a flame can ignite easily, and a machine with moving parts can grab hair and drag the head with it.
When a lamp stops working, what is the first thing to check?
Check whether it is plugged in and switched on. Because the simplest causes are the most common, and the bulb or wiring need not be touched if the power is just off.
Why do we sort dark and light clothes before washing?
Dye can run from dark clothes. Because dark clothes can let out some dye in the water, the dye could stain light clothes if they are washed together.
Why is it a good idea to leave a spare key with a trusted neighbour?
A spare key gives us a way back into the house if we are locked out. Because a trusted neighbour can open the door if we lose our own key or lock ourselves out, we are not stranded.
Why is it wise to put a piece of writing aside for a while before checking it?
A break makes mistakes easier to see. Because after we have just written something, our brain fills in what we meant to say, and with some time away we read what is really on the page.
Why is it wise to wait before replying to an angry message?
A short pause lets anger fade before we reply. Because strong anger makes us choose harsher words than we really mean, waiting lets us calm down and write a reply that is less likely to hurt.
Why should we ask before borrowing something from a classmate?
Asking lets the owner say yes or no. Because the thing belongs to the classmate and they may need it, taking it quietly can cause worry and spoil trust.
All the birds in the cage can sing. Pinto is in the cage. What can we tell about Pinto?
If Pinto is a bird, Pinto can sing. Because the rule covers only the birds in the cage, we need to know that Pinto is a bird before we can use it.
Why do roosters crow in the early morning?
Their body clock tells them dawn is near. Because they respond to light and an inner rhythm, they crow as the sky begins to brighten.
All the mangoes in the basket are ripe, and this fruit came from the basket. Is it a ripe mango?
This fruit might not be a mango. Because the premises say that every mango in the basket is ripe, they do not say that every fruit in the basket is a mango, so it could be an apple.
The target is 82 runs and the team has scored 56. How many more runs do they need?
26. Because 82 - 56 = 26, so they still need 26 runs.
What is 28 + 32?
60. Because 28 + 32 = 60, adding the tens first and then the ones.
How many minutes are there in 2 hours?
120. Because 1 hour is 60 minutes, so 2 x 60 = 120 minutes.
Is 135 more or less than 66?
More. Because 135 is over 100 and 66 is not.
I have Rs 65 and want a football that costs Rs 102. Is that enough?
No, it is not enough. Because I would need 37 more, since 102 - 65 = 37.
